facts.business: Bizotic Commercial Limited is engaged in the designing, marketing, and retailing of men's ready-made garments under its flagship brands Urban United and YARD, operating across wholesale fabrics, branded retail, exclusive brand outlets, and organised value retailing.
key_risks: Volatility in raw material and fabric prices
Intense competition from domestic and international apparel brands
Rapidly changing fashion trends and customer preferences
Supply chain disruptions and logistics costs
